comments.author: zerotool
comments.body_html: the answer to the 1st point is that you forgot to make an explosion radius for High Explosive cartridges (copy the minimum and maximum radius from the Cluster of cartridges). And as for the damage, there is an explosive strength parameter there, it is responsible for the damage of the explosion / shock wave itself. And the Damage parameter of the Cluster of cartridges is responsible for the damage of the fragment

comments.author: zerotool
comments.body_html: I do not make claims in a negative way, I apologize if I somehow offended or offended you))))

comments.author: Rising_Star
comments.body_html: No problem at all and I appreciate your feedback. The information you gave to me is really helpful. I’ll have a look at the radius and the parameter you wrote about. Thanks!

comments.author: zerotool
comments.body_html: According to the mechanics of causing explosion damage, an explosion causes damage to all parts of the body that fall into the explosion sphere. The damage inflicted is equal to the “explosion strength” parameter, damage is inflicted twice on parts of the body covered by armor. The minimum radius is the radius in which the full damage specified in the “explosion strength” parameter is applied, the maximum radius is the radius in which damage is applied in principle and at the farthest point only 20% of the specified in the “explosion strength” parameter is applied
